items.rationale: Lightning overvoltage damaged a fixed installation covered under §§2.3.3 and 4.2.3, and its location nine metres from the hob puts it outside the five-metre exclusion in §2.3.10(c). Under §§7.1.9–7.1.10, indemnity is limited to €1,411 for an equivalent 3.5 kW unit, not the chosen 7.1 kW upgrade.
Sections 7.1.9(c) and 7.1.10 cover ordinary replacement labour at the pre-loss standard. The €482 benchmark excludes any extra labour attributable to the upgrade or decorative console.

Section 7.1.10 excludes a support chosen for appearance and not required for installation. The entire line is excluded, not just the difference from a standard bracket; €60 is a conditional estimate only.
Sections 7.1.9(e) and 7.1.11–7.1.12 cover ordinary carriage attributable to the equivalent replacement. The gross freight benchmark is €42, excluding the separately billed express surcharge.
Section 7.1.12 excludes express and timed-delivery surcharges unless agreed in advance or necessary to prevent further loss; neither is shown. The €30 estimate is conditional only.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed contractor administration and paperwork charges. The €25 estimate is conditional only.
